result.title: RAVEC: Reward-Aligned Visual Evidence Correction
result.summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards improves multimodal reasoning, but response-level feedback provides limited guidance on which intermediate decisions to correct. Visual interventions reveal sensitivity to image content, yet this sensitivity alone does not establish reward alignment or support across questions. We introduce RAVEC (Reward-Aligned Visual Evidence Correction), which selects visual corrections using local and cross-question reward support and jointly determines their strengths within each response. Paired Visual Evidence Contrast (PVEC) compares predictions from an exponential moving average teacher at the same sampled response prefix under the original image and a version with its annotated evidence region suppressed, yielding signed correction directions. Credit-Risk Allocation (CRA) screens these directions using local reward alignment and reward support from other questions, excluding all responses to the source question. It then solves a response-level budgeted allocation problem, assigning additional cost to directions that locally reduce predictive entropy. The resulting signed visual loss augments Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) during training. Inference uses only the original image and question. Across ten multimodal benchmarks, RAVEC achieves the highest average accuracy among the compared methods with both 3B and 7B Qwen2.5-VL-Instruct models, outperforming GRPO by 2.67 and 1.39 percentage points, respectively. Component ablations support the combined design of evidence alignment, credit qualification, and risk-aware allocation. The project is available at https://yangjj007.github.io/ravec/.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 RAVEC，通过抑制标注证据区域构造成对视觉对比，得到带符号的修正方向，并用局部奖励一致性与跨问题奖励支持进行筛选和预算分配，将视觉损失加入 GRPO 训练以改进多模态推理。
AI.relevance_reason: 直接处理视觉证据敏感性、中间决策的贡献分配与训练监督，并明确推理时仅用原图；其证据方向筛选和风险分配可供核查 THINK/LOOK 中视觉证据选择与信用分配的联系。
